providers.name: DORIA.png
providers.reason: Morpheus motor lamedb explicitly contains p:doria for RadioRomaTelevision and Radio Roma (SID 6805/6806 TSID 26849 ONID 8572, 9E). Exact supplied group graphic reused from approved MASTER V9 donor in all three backgrounds, not a claim that every current provider field is DORIA.

providers.name: GTSS.png
providers.reason: Historical logo and provider GTSS confirmed.
